caption: Ready to whip up a delicious and nutritious snack? 🌱 This Easy Greek Hummus is not only super simple to make but packed with flavor! Here’s what you’ll need: Ingredients: ✅ 1 can of chickpeas (drained and rinsed) ✅ 2 tablespoons tahini ✅ Juice of 1 lemon ✅ 1 clove of garlic ✅ 2 tablespoons olive oil (plus extra for drizzling) ✅ A handful of fresh parsley ✅ Salt to taste ✅ Paprika for garnish Enjoy this creamy hummus with veggies, pita, or your favorite crackers!
